baseline.name: Remove each candidate and rescan parity sums
baseline.approach: For every removal index, walk all remaining values and recompute even/odd totals.

why: Removing an index swaps only the right suffix's parity, so four rolling sums evaluate a candidate without rescanning it.
quantitative_comparison: The baseline can inspect n*(n-1) retained values across all removals. The archive uses two complete input passes and constant arithmetic per candidate; no elapsed multiplier is measured.
tradeoffs: Requires sums representable by long long and careful parity bookkeeping. It does not beat every alternative O(n) prefix-sum solution in time growth, though it avoids their prefix arrays.
evidence_basis: Static count/parity transformation versus the explicitly defined rescan baseline; no benchmark.
